channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: On war powers, questions aren’t a working substitute for action
item.description: The Iran strikes highlight a long pattern of presidents waging war without congressional declarations — and a Congress that asks questions instead of enforcing constitutional limits.

item.title: A year into Trump 2.0, North Carolinians are already looking for change
item.description: Rising turnout, shifting independents and new polling suggest North Carolina voters are souring on Trump a year into his second term and leaning toward change in 2026.

item.title: Currituck tax case raises interesting questions for top NC court
item.description: A Currituck County dispute over using occupancy taxes for law enforcement has reached North Carolina’s Supreme Court, raising key questions about tourism funding rules and future local tax fights.

item.title: NAACP grant to fund public forums
item.description: Wilson NAACP branch receives $25K grant to host community forums on youth success, civics education and parent involvement, starting with a March 16 event at Wilson Community College.

item.title: ‘Borrowed Light’: Wilson Active Artists Association opens new exhibit
item.description: “Borrowed Light,” a new Wilson Active Artists Association exhibit at the Edna Boykin Cultural Center’s Hammond Gallery, showcases more than 60 works by 27 artists March 5–May 23.

item.title: GOP rallying at Thursday council meeting
item.description: The Wilson County Republican Party is attending Thursday morning’s Wilson City Council work session to “show support for Wilson’s sovereignty and protection from becoming a sanctuary city.”

item.title: AREA ROUNDUP: High-scoring Fike thumps Rolesville 7-3 for 3-0 start
item.description: Fike girls soccer kept its red-hot attack rolling with a 7-3 win over Rolesville for a 3-0 start, while Hunt edged Cleveland 2-1 in a rain-delayed season opener.

item.title: Earnhardt grandson Wyatt Miller to make LMSC debut at Southern National
item.description: Dale Earnhardt’s grandson Wyatt Miller will make his Late Model Stock Car debut in the Jerry Moody Memorial at Southern National, kicking off four nights of racing for JR Motorsports during Speed Week 2026.

item.title: Bulldogs’ season ends with OT loss at Emmanuel
item.description: Barton’s season ends in OT as Emmanuel escapes 81-77 despite Jaylen Faber’s late four-point play; Devin Story scores 28 and Ezra McKee’s tip-in delivers the decisive points.

item.title: Knight, Barbrey advance to Wilson sheriff showdown
item.description: Republican Bobby Knight and Democrat Brandon Barbrey clinched their primaries Tuesday, setting up a November showdown for Wilson County sheriff as other local, state and federal races took shape in low-turnout voting.
